history.period: Modern local temple; founding date undocumented
history.summary: Generic CSV name ('Kali Mandir, Siwan') has no single documented referent: Siwan district has many Kali shrines (Husena Kali Mandir, Kali Mandir Khaira, Rampur Kali Mandir at Barhipurgop, Teotha Kali Mandir, Kachahari Durga Mandir, Kali Mata at Gopalpur). This file documents Husena Kali Mandir at Husena Dakhin Tola, Siwan (JustDial 4.2, 29 ratings) as the best-listed in-town candidate. No published history, dynasty, or founder exists for it; listings are directory-class only. Identity ambiguous — flag before publishing as 'the' Kali Mandir of Siwan. Coordinates are Siwan town-level approximations, not the temple POI. Media image is a Google user photo labeled 'Kali Maa Mandir in the city Siwan' (200, image/jpeg) — on-topic by place label but weak provenance.

name: Kali Mandir (Husena, Siwan)
town_description: Siwan is a city and district headquarters in northwestern Bihar on the Saran–Gopalganj corridor, with a busy junction (Siwan Junction) on the Chhapra–Gorakhpur rail line. Nearby attractions include the Mahendranath Shiva temple at Mehdar and the Dakshina Kali shrine at Darauli.

travel.airport: Jayprakash Narayan International Airport, Patna (~140 km)
travel.road: Siwan town; Husena Dakhin Tola within municipal limits

visitor_information.best_time: October–March; Navratri/Kali Puja for festival darshan
